name: claude
title: Claude — answer in channels
description: Answers channel cards. When you type a message into a card addressed to 'claude', this runs `claude -p` with the conversation and posts the reply back into the card — so the card can start a turn instead of only being read by an agent you already summoned. Without something that can wake an agent, a channel is strictly worse than a terminal, which is the whole reason this exists. With no `claude` on PATH it says so and posts nothing.

config.label: Answer automatically (yes/no)
config.help: Default yes. Set to no to stop it running on change while leaving it installed — the Run button still works.

config.label: Working directory for Claude
config.help: Where `claude -p` runs, which decides what it can see. Blank uses the plugin's own folder. A project checkout is the useful answer.

config.label: Give up after (seconds)
config.help: Default 240. A turn that runs longer is abandoned and reported; nothing is posted.

config.label: Most messages to answer in one run
config.help: Default 3. A guard: an import or a paste can put many messages in a channel at once, and each answer is a real model call.
